title: Vanillect
description: A modpack that expands & enhances Minecraft without adding new blocks or items to the game; keeping it vanilla friendly
body:
### Introduction

**Vanillect** is a carefully curated vanilla-friendly modpack that **expands and deeply enriches** the Minecraft experience without ever adding new blocks, items, ores, mobs or dimensions to the game.

Instead it focuses entirely on

- Making existing mechanics deeper, smoother &/or more satisfying  
- Bringing vanilla structures, biomes & systems to their full potential  
- Adding meaningful quality-of-life improvements  
- Enhancing exploration, combat, building & survival  
- Polishing every rough edge while keeping 100% vanilla vibes & feeling

If you love vanilla Minecraft but wish everything felt a little bigger, better connected, or more alive — this is the pack for you.

### Origins

Vanillect was inspired in part by Hytale. Playing it revealed just how empty & lifeless Vanilla Minecraft's world's feel, but I couldn't stomach the alternative: modpacks that reinvent the game entirely, bloating it with new content that leaves worlds broken if you ever try to uninstall. Vanillect breathes better exploration & more into Minecraft without changing a thing.

### Alternative Mod Options

In a couple of spots I couldn't pick just one mods; each bring something great to the table. So I've included two strong options per category (with the pack's default marked). Feel free to swap them out in your mod list if you think the alternative works better for you.

**Biome Overhauls**

**Geophilic**
- Super vanilla friendly, but doesn't make your world feel as lively as WWOO

**William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld** [Modpack Default]
- World's feel even more alive & grand, but may make some biomes look fundamentally different. If you want familiarity, Geophilic is better

**Combat Overhauls**

**Combatify** [Modpack Default]
- Revamps the 1.9 combats system, inspired heavily by the Minecraft combat rework snapshots; a hybrid between 1.8 & 1.9, with new additions

**Combat Nouveau**
- Tweaks & improvements to 1.9's combat system that makes the game more challenging; but while feeling very similar to vanilla 1.9 combat
